summary: Gang rape and kidnapping of minor girl; sole testimony of prosecutrix sufficient for conviction if reliable; consent alleged due to prolonged association and lack of resistance; medical evidence of habitual sexual intercourse not determinative of consent; delayed FIR not fatal if adequately explained; age of prosecutrix below 18 confirmed by dental opinion; conviction upheld under IPC s.363, s.366, s.376(2)(g); double punishment under s.363 and s.366 set aside for some accused; appeal allowed in part, conviction sustained, sentence modified.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; conviction under s.363, s.366 and s.376(2)(g) upheld; sentence for s.363 set aside for some accused under s.71 IPC; sentences for remaining offences upheld.
